**Overview**  
Mutiara Delima Agro Sdn. Bhd. operates an oil‑palm plantation and supplies fresh fruit bunches from Kuala Lumpur. The private limited company was incorporated on 11 April 2023, making it roughly one year old. Ownership is concentrated, with the largest shareholder (Director 3) holding 58.92 % of the equity; the board comprises four directors. Financial data are limited to a single year (2024), showing revenue of RM 74,303,529, total equity of RM 66,068,376, and a current ratio of 2.9. No legal cases are recorded.
